# **Findings from the Northern Camp**

The company plans to open three service centers before the end of the year. The committee met on Tuesday to review the proposed budget for the coming year. He described the process patiently, pausing whenever someone raised a hand.

## **Open Questions**

The train left the station four minutes late and still arrived on schedule. The factory now recycles nearly ninety percent of the water it uses each day. Nobody expected the small town to host a festival of that size. The new policy takes effect on the first day of the next quarter.
